description: William Shakespeare's burial place is in the chancel of Holy Trinity Church, Stratford-upon-Avon, United Kingdom. The parish burial entry is dated 25 April 1616. The map point refers to the church, not a surveyed grave location.
description_zh: 莎士比亚的坟墓位于英国埃文河畔斯特拉特福的圣三一教堂（Holy Trinity Church）室内圣坛区（chancel）。教区登记记载其于1616年4月25日安葬；选择该埋葬阶段可对照1616年的历史政权疆域。地图采用所在教堂的参考位置，不是墓穴精确坐标。
details: Scope: William Shakespeare's grave inside the church chancel; the wall memorial and the entire listed church are distinct scopes. The source register is DR243/1, burial register, fol.46r. The default phase records the burial event in 1616, not construction of the church, Shakespeare's lifespan or continuous existence of the grave. Chinese names and summaries are editorial translations of the cited identity and evidence. Church reference point: Wikidata Q472082, P625; its declared numeric precision is not surveyed accuracy of the indoor grave. No manuscript image or full source page is redistributed.

geography.note: Modern country and church identity from Q472082 P17=Q145 and P1216=1187824. The grave is inside this church according to the official church source. The point represents the church only; no historical political affiliation is inferred.
